title: Muse Spark 1.1 adapter and promotion benchmark
description: Build a reproducible cross-model benchmark packet and Meta Model API adapter to evaluate Muse Spark 1.1 for potential inclusion in the model-routing stack, requiring operator-approved disposition (REJECTED, BOUNDED_USE, or PROMOTED_WITH_SCOPE) based on correctness, safety, latency, cost, and reliability gates.
pain_point: No existing adapter or evidence packet for Muse Spark 1.1, making it impossible to make a data-driven promotion decision; vendor claims are unverified and must be separated from third-party evaluations and local observations.
use_case: The user is designing and implementing a systematic evaluation framework to assess Muse Spark 1.1 against incumbent models using bounded tasks, provider-policy declaration, and fixed benchmark packet, with the goal of producing a decision record that selects exactly one terminal disposition.

title: Fresh active inbox for exact HVAC review notes
description: 用户需要一个新鲜活跃的收件箱来存储最新的HVAC审查笔记，确保笔记完整且短小，以便ChatGPT/Codex等AI工具能够读取完整文本，并保留页面标签、路由、URL、视口、用户代理、优先级、类型和可见上下文。
pain_point: 收件箱过长导致笔记被截断，AI工具无法读取完整文本；需要频繁轮换收件箱以避免截断，且必须手动维护笔记的精确文本和上下文信息。
use_case: 使用ChatGPT/Codex工具读取HVAC审查笔记，要求笔记完整且附有页面标签、路由、URL、视口、用户代理、优先级、类型和可见上下文，避免因收件箱过长导致截断，并在操作前引用或总结最新笔记文本及来源页面。

title: 第一方PDF查看器缺失：sandbox生成的PDF无法直接查看
description: 用户通过 `gipity sandbox run` 运行了一次性数据任务（CSV输入，PDF报告输出），但代理生成了PDF后，没有平台内建命令来查看该PDF，只能手动调用 `pdftoppm` 将PDF栅格化为PNG，再通过 `Read` 工具查看。这一过程需要多次重复，且每次栅格化都需要额外的sandbox调用，浪费时间和资源。用户希望沙箱能提供第一方的方式来查看生成的文档（如PDF、docx等），避免手动栅格化和重复工作。
pain_point: 没有第一方方式查看生成的PDF，代理不得不手动栅格化PDF为图像后再查看，导致额外的sandbox调用和重复工作；每次sandbox生成文档（PDF、docx等）都会遇到同样的障碍，效率低下且浪费资源。
use_case: 用户使用 `gipity sandbox run` 执行一次性的CSV转PDF报告任务，代理生成PDF后，需要通过视觉确认布局再完成任务。用户手动编写命令 `pdftoppm -png -r 90 docs/sales-report.pdf docs/preview` 在第二个sandbox中栅格化PDF，然后使用 `Read` 查看PNG，并在修复图表后重复了一次栅格化-查看循环。

title: Deterministic stepping of game loop for headless canvas verification
description: Gipity platform needs a tool or capability that allows an agent to deterministically step through a running game loop in a headless browser, enabling verification of real-time canvas applications (e.g., physics, animations, collision detection). Currently, `page eval` only runs in real time; slow rendering (e.g., 14.5fps) prevents the ball from reaching bricks in a reasonable duration, leading to false negatives. The platform's own warning advises agents to 'step the app's own loop deterministically', but no such tool exists. As a result, agents abandon real-time verification and ship untested core mechanics.
pain_point: The headless browser cannot run the render loop at sufficient real-time speed (14.5fps) to let the ball travel far enough to hit bricks within a practical eval window; the platform's warning points at a 'step the loop deterministically' path that the CLI and skills do not provide, leaving the agent with no working tool for verification; agent abandons real-time verification entirely, taking only a static screenshot, so brick collision, scoring, lives, and win/game-over screens are never tested, risking undetected defects in core gameplay.
use_case: Agent built a Phaser brick-breaker game and attempted to verify the real gameplay loop (ball bounces, bricks break, score increments, lives decrement) by driving the deployed page with `gipity page eval`. First two evals sampled ball position over time. Third eval aimed to confirm a brick collision and score change, but platform returned slow-render warning (14.5fps) and advised to 'step the app's own loop deterministically'. Agent had no follow-up move, dropped real-time verification, took a static screenshot, and shipped the game with its core mechanic (brick collision -> score -> win/lose transitions) never exercised.

title: WhatsApp Business API Integration for Unified Inbox
description: Integrate WhatsApp Business API into the OHC unified inbox so owners can receive, triage, and reply to WhatsApp messages directly within OHC, eliminating context switching and fragmented customer history.
pain_point: WhatsApp messages are disconnected from the OHC ecosystem, requiring owners to constantly switch apps, causing missed leads, untracked deposits, and fragmented customer history, breaking the 'One Assistant' promise.
use_case: Owner/operator personas like Maya (Home Baker) and Fatima (Food Cart Operator) rely on direct messages to capture demand, confirm orders, and coordinate pickups. They need to manage WhatsApp messages inside OHC without switching to personal/business WhatsApp app.

title: 自动生成advisory报告的需求
description: 用户描述了一个需要系统自动收集advisory agents的分析结果并生成摘要报告的需求，作为Hive系统的一部分。
pain_point: 缺乏自动化的汇总机制，无法高效整合advisory agents的发现。
use_case: Hive agents在advisory模式下分析代码并发布发现，但不会创建issue或PR；需要系统自动生成总结报告。

title: 隐私安全的Skill使用日志收集
description: 将当前收集自由格式args的TSV日志改为只收集必要字段的v2 JSONL，使用privacy-safe的session_key替代raw session id，避免收集user/repo/args等敏感数据。
pain_point: 当前日志收集了不必要的自由格式args，导致隐私风险，且无法区分hook关闭与真实零调用的健康信号。
use_case: 在Claude Skill调用时记录使用日志，生成使用报告，同时保护用户隐私，避免收集不必要的args、user、repo等敏感信息。

title: run-da native fan-out lifecycle을 capability 기반 lifecycle·slot 계약으로 전환
description: Direct Codex surface의 문서와 실제 codex-cli 0.144.1의 live developer surface가 불일치하여 문서대로 실행하면 실패함. runtime mapping을 유지하되 실제 tool availability와 advertised slot으로 current/legacy profile을 선택하도록 변경. explicit close가 없는 current surface와 fixed close가 있는 legacy surface를 구분하고, unknown은 serial/bounded batch로 fail-safe 처리.
pain_point: 문서에 전제된 close_agent가 실제 surface에 없고, root 포함 동시 slot도 문서의 고정값(6)과 다르며, 코드를 문서대로 실행하면 실패함. 현재 surface에 맞춰 profile을 선택하지 않으면 거짓 안전(false safety)을 만들게 됨.
use_case: Direct Codex를 사용한 agent fan-out 실행 시, 문서에 명시된 close_agent와 6 threads 고정값이 codex-cli 0.144.1의 실제 surface(spawn_agent, send_message, followup_task, wait_agent, interrupt_agent, list_agents, active slot 4개)와 달라, FULL reviewer 4개를 batch로 띄우거나 없는 close를 호출하면 실패함. 따라서 실제 tool availability와 advertised slot을 기반으로 capability profile을 선택해야 함.

title: Replace boolean tool outcomes with native error semantics
description: Replace the boolean `ok` field in KhalaToolResult with a closed union of success and failure variants, where validation failures use a stable error code `invalid_issue_packet` and structured violations, avoiding duplicated success state and visual burden.
pain_point: Duplicates success state, treats validation failure as success, and adds visual burden.
use_case: All six runtime tools share `KhalaToolResult`, a public envelope discriminated by `ok`. `khala_triage.validate` reports both a conforming packet and a nonconforming packet as successful tool executions; the latter is only distinguishable through `data.valid: false`. The Pi adapter serializes the complete envelope into visible tool content, rendering a normal validation as `{ ok: true, summary: "Issue conforms to the triage template.", data: { valid: true, missing: [] } }`.

use_case: Analyzing code and posting findings in advisory mode without creating issues or PRs

title: Make VoltAgent vNext an ai-sdk-first outer framework
description: The core API should reuse ai-sdk names, options, semantics, and types directly instead of wrapping them, with VoltAgent-specific features under a `voltagent` namespace. This eliminates semantic drift, duplicated types, and blocked access to newer ai-sdk capabilities.
pain_point: Current `agent.generateText(input, options)` is positional not object-style; hand-written `BaseGenerationOptions` duplicates and extends `Partial<CallSettings>`; parallel concepts like `maxSteps`, `stop`, `context`, `UsageInfo`, `Tool`, `LLMProvider` create semantic drift and block access to newer ai-sdk capabilities.
use_case: Developer refactoring VoltAgent core to align public generation APIs with ai-sdk v7, reusing ai-sdk types, providing an escape hatch to raw ai-sdk calls, and preserving VoltAgent value (workflows, memory, guardrails, observability).

title: Document AI endpoints in OpenAPI spec
description: The AI endpoints (/ai/chat, /ai/object, /ai/files) are currently intentionally excluded from the public OpenAPI specification, marked as studio-internal tooling. There is a need to document these endpoints to reduce spec drift and enable discovery for external users or automated tools, or at least clarify their exclusion in the documentation.
pain_point: The AI endpoints are not exposed in the public spec, causing spec drift and making it impossible for external tools or users to discover or integrate with Directus AI features without reading source code. The intentional exclusion without clear public documentation creates confusion about their availability and usage.
use_case: A developer performing a systematic review of controller routes against OpenAPI spec paths to identify undocumented endpoints, and found that AI-related endpoints (chat, object, files) are deliberately omitted because they require app:true accountability and are meant for in-studio use only. The task is to decide whether to add them to the spec or continue exclusion.

title: Configure required E2E status checks to unlock 7-day consecutive green
description: The user needs to set the five E2E workflow jobs as required status checks in branch protection across three repos (clawmetry, clawmetry-cloud, clawmetry-landing). Currently, PRs can merge even when E2E fails, blocking the 7-consecutive-day countdown for all 7 criteria to be green.
pain_point: C6 Required-status-checks is RED because none of the E2E workflows are configured as required status checks. This means PRs can merge even when E2E fails, and the 7-day countdown cannot begin. The fix requires a manual admin action (not code change) that cannot be set via Actions YAML.
use_case: As a repository maintainer, I need to add the following job names as required status checks on the main branch of each repo: 'OSS golden path (wheel + OpenClaw + 9 tabs)', 'Cross-repo handoff (C4)', 'visual-diff' for clawmetry; 'Cloud golden-path browser E2E' for clawmetry-cloud; 'Landing golden path (C3)' for clawmetry-landing. This must be done via GitHub Settings UI or gh CLI so that the E2E robustness epic can achieve 7 consecutive days of all green criteria and disable the cron trigger.

title: Flexible agent permission management for issue/PR creation

title: Evidence-driven follow-up to track real Praxis skill misses
description: Establish an evidence-driven process to record and address skill misses revealed during implementations, audits, and migrations after the 161-skill reconciliation, with clear classification and risk assessment to prevent validation gaps and incorrect routing.
pain_point: Skills may route to wrong canonical owner, allow weak validation closure, recommend local adaptation when platform/contract is correct, be outdated relative to artifacts like praxis-ui-angular, or miss recurrent tasks requiring uncodified knowledge, leading to validation gaps, incorrect decision-making, and platform coupling risks.
use_case: Track real skill misses found during implementations, audits, and migrations using Praxis in Ergon acceleration, where each miss is documented with implementation/audit details, involved skill, canonical source audited, adherence classification (ja-suportado-so-ux, ja-suportado-mal-nomeado-ou-mal-materializado, suportado-parcialmente, lacuna-real-de-contrato), practical risk, and expected validation after fix.

title: 本地编码模型需避免循环并具备强工程能力
description: 用户测试超过50个本地编码模型后发现，上下文大小是最大瓶颈，且许多编码代理容易陷入循环，需要持续监控。最终推荐了表现最佳的REAM-192模型，它在五项盲测工程挑战中均表现优异，具有强工程判断、架构能力和调试纪律。
pain_point: 许多编码代理会陷入循环并需要不断手动监控（constant babysitting），导致效率低下；同时本地模型的上下文大小成为最大瓶颈，限制了任务处理能力。
use_case: 在RX 9070 XT 16GB + 3060ti 8GB的消费级硬件上运行本地模型，用于编码任务如构建贪吃蛇游戏、个人任务管理器、迷你版本控制系统、日志分析器等，期望模型能自主完成复杂工程任务且不陷入循环。

title: Add execution context switching to workers
description: Allow mcp-server to switch its execution context to dedicated workers, replicating the DevTools dropdown that lets developers select the main thread or active workers. This would enable Runtime.evaluate calls to execute within a specific worker's global scope, providing interactive debugging for multi-threaded applications.
pain_point: Currently unable to interact with a dedicated worker's scope via mcp-server; cannot run commands like `Neo.get('my-component-id')` to inspect live objects inside the worker, as mcp-server appears bound to the main thread's execution context.
use_case: Integrating mcp-server into the Neo.mjs framework workflow to give AI development agent Gemini 2.5 Pro the ability to 'see' and interact with UI. The framework's OMT architecture runs nearly all application logic inside workers, so the agent needs to inspect live objects like `Neo.get('my-component-id')` that exist only within a worker's scope.

title: 修复 gh shim 递归选择另一个 aidevops shim 的问题
description: 当长会话的 PATH 中同时包含不可变运行时包 shim 和可变安装 shim 时，gh shim 会递归调用另一个 aidevops shim，导致命令超时（exit 124），阻塞 issue reads、claims、PR operations、diagnostics 和 pulse routines。要求 shim 最多经过一次 aidevops shim 后正确解析并执行原生 GitHub CLI，且紧急绕过 AIDEVOPS_GH_SHIM_DISABLE=1 也能正常工作。
pain_point: gh shim 的 _find_real_gh() 只排除自己的目录，若有其他 aidevops shim generation 也在 PATH 上，它会错误地选择另一个 shim 而不是原生 gh，导致递归调用直到外部超时（exit 124），阻塞所有 gh 命令，浪费诊断时间，且紧急绕过 AIDEVOPS_GH_SHIM_DISABLE=1 也无效。
use_case: 用户使用 aidevops 的 gh shim 调用 GitHub CLI 进行各种操作（如 gh --version, gh issue view 等），PATH 中同时存在不可变运行时包 shim（agents/scripts）和可变安装 shim（agents/scripts），期望 shim 正确找到原生 gh 并执行，但实际发生递归调用导致超时。

title: 自动更新AI Portal Docker镜像
description: 从Dependency Dashboard中可见，AI Portal的Docker镜像需要从v1.0.3更新到v1.0.4，但用户未主动表达需求，仅为系统自动化依赖更新。
pain_point: 依赖版本落后可能导致功能缺失或安全漏洞，但当前没有用户反馈具体影响。
use_case: 维护1Panel应用商店中AI Portal的Docker镜像版本，确保使用最新功能和安全修复。

title: fetch_remote_versions stall: per-component timeout diagnostics needed
description: User reports that `homeboy status wp-build-runtime --timings` stalls indefinitely at `fetch_remote_versions` phase, exceeding 120 seconds without rendering a dashboard or identifying the specific component probe. Expected behavior includes bounded intervals, independent deadlines for each probe, explicit actionable diagnostics for timed-out components, and cleanup of child process groups.
pain_point: The command stalls indefinitely at `fetch_remote_versions` without rendering a dashboard or identifying the specific component probe; no independent deadlines exist for network, git, SSH, release, and component probes; failed or timed-out components are silently omitted instead of showing explicit actionable diagnostics; timed-out child process groups are not cleaned up.
use_case: Running `homeboy status wp-build-runtime --timings` to check build status with timing breakdown; the command completes `resolve_project_components` and `read_local_versions` phases but then stalls at `fetch_remote_versions` phase without any progress output for over two minutes.

title: Show free-shipping progress right after add-to-cart
description: Include free shipping progress (threshold, remaining, qualified) in the add_to_cart tool response when a free-shipping threshold is configured, computed from the real cart total via the existing helper, to nudge shoppers at the highest-leverage moment.
pain_point: The add_to_cart response currently lacks free shipping progress, missing the most effective moment to nudge 'add $X more for free shipping' and lift order value.
use_case: A shopper adds an item to cart; the system immediately shows the remaining amount needed for free shipping to encourage an additional purchase.

title: Fix WS client disconnect mid-turn in Agent API
description: When a WebSocket client disconnects mid-turn while orchestrator.run() is active, the run is abandoned and the pooled session is poisoned with dangling tool_calls, causing subsequent requests on that session to misbehave. The fix must handle disconnection gracefully, clean up tool_calls, and allow safe reuse of the pooled session.
pain_point: WebSocket client disconnect mid-turn abandons orchestrator.run() and poisons the pooled session with dangling tool_calls, so subsequent chat turns on the same session fail or behave incorrectly.
use_case: User interacts with the AI agent via WebSocket for a multi-turn conversation. When the WebSocket client disconnects mid-turn (e.g., due to network drop), the agent’s orchestration must handle the disconnection without corrupting session state.

title: Fix externally launched Spring crash with code 0
description: User reports that an externally launched Spring application crashes with exit code 0, indicating an unexpected termination or startup failure. The exact cause and context are not provided in the report.
pain_point: The application crashes immediately after launch with exit code 0, preventing any normal operation or debugging without additional error details.
use_case: Externally launching a Spring application (likely via command line or container), expecting it to start and run successfully.

title: Add Sparkle to Scoop package manager
description: Users who rely on Scoop for package management currently have no way to install and update Sparkle through Scoop, as it is only available via the official website's .exe installer or Chocolatey. This request proposes adding Sparkle to Scoop to allow installation with 'scoop install sparkle' and updates with 'scoop update sparkle', streamlining the workflow for Scoop users.
pain_point: No streamlined way to install and update Sparkle through Scoop, which is a preferred tool among developers and power users, forcing them to use alternative methods that are less integrated with their workflow.
use_case: Install and update Sparkle using Scoop package manager on Windows, specifically with commands 'scoop install sparkle' and 'scoop update sparkle', instead of using the official .exe installer or Chocolatey.

title: Dependency Dashboard for automated updates
description: Users rely on Renovate's Dependency Dashboard to track and manage dependency updates, including pending automerges and open pull requests.
pain_point: Manual tracking of dependency updates across multiple branches and PRs would be time-consuming; the Dashboard centralizes visibility.
use_case: Monitoring and managing dependency updates via the Dependency Dashboard, with pending branches for automerge and open PRs.

title: Public Success Showcase & Cumulative Impact Dashboard
description: Build a public-facing showcase displaying cumulative impact (total PRs created, time saved, issues resolved, cost per issue) with anonymized examples of successful pipeline runs, and generate shareable HTML reports with before/after diffs, execution timeline, and cost breakdown to drive adoption.
pain_point: Zero pipeline activity suggests an adoption problem; success is not visible or compelling enough to drive adoption, and there is no easy way to share anonymized examples of successful pipeline runs with cumulative metrics.
use_case: A user or team wants to showcase the cumulative impact of their pipeline runs (e.g., total PRs created, time saved, issues resolved) to stakeholders or the community, using a public dashboard and shareable reports with before/after diffs, execution timeline, and cost breakdown, in order to drive adoption of the tool.

title: Multi-Agent Coordination Health Monitor with Deadlock Detection
description: Build a real-time monitor that tracks agent task completion, detects stuck agents, identifies coordination bottlenecks, and triggers auto-recovery (task reassignment, agent restart, or escalation to PM agent) to reduce coordination-related failures by 40%+.
pain_point: Team-based pipelines fail due to agent coordination issues (deadlocks, blocking, idle agents) that don't show up in single-agent scenarios, leading to stuck pipelines and no built-in recovery mechanism.
use_case: Team-based pipelines where agents collaborate; need to detect deadlocks, blocked agents, and idle agents that cause failures not visible in single-agent scenarios. Desired outcome: real-time visibility, auto-recovery, and 40%+ reduction in coordination failures.

title: Microsoft Fabric AI tools row-level security with service principal authentication
description: 用户需要了解如何在Microsoft Fabric中，当使用AI工具（如Fabric Data Agent、自定义Copilot）查询数据时，实现行级安全（RLS），特别是如何通过服务主体认证传递凭据，使得AI工具只返回用户有权查看的数据。用户已经尝试了多种存储方案但未找到答案，需要技术指导。
pain_point: 用户无法找到如何在使用服务主体认证时，将请求中的凭据传递到底层数据库并让AI工具（Copilot）尊重行级安全的明确答案或解决方案。
use_case: 用户正在构建一个前端应用，让用户通过AI工具（如Copilot）提问数据，但数据访问必须遵循行级安全规则。用户考虑了语义模型、Fabric warehouse和lakehouse作为存储方案，并希望弄清楚如何在使用服务主体认证时，将请求中的凭据传递到底层数据库并让Copilot尊重RLS。

title: Integrating Claude AI into ML project for data analysis and predictions
description: User wants to know if Claude AI can be integrated into a machine learning project for tasks like data analysis, text processing, predictions, or building intelligent features, and seeks the best way to use it in such a project.
pain_point: Uncertainty about Claude AI's capabilities for integration into an ML project and lack of clear guidance on the best way to use it for these tasks.
use_case: Working on a machine learning project and would like to integrate Claude AI into the application for tasks such as data analysis, text processing, predictions, or building intelligent features within an ML-based system.

title: Comparing HTML tables using AI tools in Python
description: User wants to use AI tools to compare two HTML tables and determine if they describe the same concepts, seeking accessible examples and resources for implementing a smarter method than brute-force row label intersection.
pain_point: Existing AI tool documentation and examples are too general, making it daunting to start. User struggles with how to pass tables for inspection and specify attributes, leading to reliance on brute-force methods that feel mechanical and less artful.
use_case: Comparing two HTML tables to determine if they describe the same concepts. Current approach: extract all row labels, create a set of unique row labels, compare new table's row labels against the set, and declare a match if intersection is large. User wants to pass exemplar tables and a candidate table for inspection, specifying which attributes should be considered.

title: 从视频中提取相机运动关键帧的Python工具
description: 用户需要能够从视频（例如无人机飞行视频）中提取相机运动关键帧，导出为文件，并输入到AI艺术动画中。希望找到Python脚本、库或Colab笔记本，且能集成到个人AI工具笔记本中。
pain_point: 只找到Blender的例子，没有现成的独立Python工具或库，不知道从何开始编程实现
use_case: 从无人机飞行视频中提取相机关键帧运动，导出为文件，输入到AI艺术动画，并集成到个人AI工具Colab笔记本

title: DeviantArt API: Check if deviation has 'created using AI tools' disclaimer
description: The DeviantArt API does not currently include the AI notice disclaimer in the extended metadata response. User needs an API endpoint to check if a deviation has the 'created using AI tools' disclaimer.
pain_point: The API response does not include the AI notice disclaimer, and the user cannot determine if a deviation has the disclaimer using the current endpoint
use_case: Using DeviantArt API to retrieve a deviation's extended metadata and check if it has the 'created using AI tools' disclaimer

title: Kaggle竞赛中技能与AI工具投入的相对重要性
description: 用户担心Kaggle竞赛中，AI工具（尤其是AI tokens）的使用是否已经使技能的重要性下降，成功主要取决于花费更多tokens和自动化。想知道当前技能在比赛中仍占多大比重。
pain_point: 用户担心自己的投入（时间和努力）可能因AI工具而贬值，技能不再是决定性因素，成功可能被金钱投入取代，这降低了入门竞争的公平性和价值感。
use_case: 用户计划进入Kaggle竞赛，但面临不确定性：在AI辅助工具有效自动化任务和链式利用漏洞的背景下，他需要了解实际技能（如手动分析、创造性问题解决）是否仍能带来竞争优势，还是主要依靠预算购买AI tokens和自动化流程。

title: Best practices for safe AI integration without over-reliance
description: Users need guidelines for responsibly integrating AI tools like LLMs into production workflows, balancing productivity gains with human oversight and validation to avoid subtle errors, edge-case bugs, and unchecked acceptances that may become technical debt.
pain_point: AI often produces confident but subtly incorrect outputs, introduces edge-case bugs in generated code, and team members may accept responses without fully reviewing them, risking long-term quality and reliability.
use_case: Integrating AI tools (LLMs) into workflow for content drafting, code suggestions, and internal automation, seeking proven patterns like human-in-the-loop and output validation layers to reduce risk while maintaining productivity.

title: 解决CREW AI工具无法使用ChatGroq的问题
description: 用户已按照CREW AI文档在tools.py和agents.py中添加了ChatGroq配置，但运行时仍然报错，需要帮助解决集成问题。
pain_point: 按照官方文档方法配置ChatGroq后，运行CREW AI时仍然报错，无法成功使用ChatGroq。
use_case: 在CREW AI框架中配置和使用ChatGroq作为LLM，按照文档在tools.py和agents.py中设置后运行出现错误。

title: Methodology to search for coding solutions without relying on AI tools
description: The user fears that relying on AI tools to solve coding problems is killing their problem-solving skills, thinking skills, focus, and understanding. They want a methodology to search for solutions independently before resorting to AI.
pain_point: Immediately running to AI tools replaces the brain, causing a fear of losing core problem-solving and thinking abilities, leading to an inability to focus and understand coding issues independently.
use_case: When facing a difficult technical issue while writing code and unsure how to search for it, the user wants a systematic methodology to find solutions without immediately using AI tools.

title: Generate PPT slides from Excel rows using AI tools
description: The user wants to generate a PowerPoint presentation with one slide per row from an Excel sheet, selecting multiple rows up to 300, using only free AI tools.
pain_point: Lack of a free AI tool that can automatically generate PPT slides from Excel data for up to 300 rows.
use_case: The user has an Excel sheet with several fields and wants to generate a PPT with one slide per row (having selected multiple rows), up to 300 rows, using free AI tools.

title: Prevent LLM from repeating tool output in Markdown
description: When using AI SDK's streamText(), the LLM's text response includes a full Markdown-formatted version of the tool output, duplicating the data already rendered as a UI component. The user wants the LLM to generate only a short summary or context, not repeat the entire tool output in Markdown. Adjusting system prompt did not work.
pain_point: Cannot prevent LLM from outputting the full tool result in Markdown format in its text response, even after explicitly instructing it via system prompt to only provide a short summary and not repeat the tool output.
use_case: Using AI SDK streamText() in a React app with OpenAI provider, where tool results are rendered as dedicated UI components, but the LLM's text response still includes a Markdown-formatted copy of the full tool data instead of a brief textual summary.

title: How to use spring-ai tools with OpenRouter Gemini models
description: 用户尝试在spring-ai中使用OpenRouter Gemini模型时，工具调用无法正常工作（返回null结果并出现警告），希望找到配置方法使工具调用生效，或者判断是spring-ai还是OpenRouter的问题。
pain_point: 使用Gemini模型时出现警告"Received null tool result from the model. This model might not support tools or the tool calls are not being properly handled."，返回null结果，导致输出与预期不符，而使用其他模型（如OpenAI）时工具调用正常，用户无法确定是spring-ai配置问题还是OpenRouter兼容性问题。
use_case: 在spring-ai中通过OpenRouter统一API调用Gemini模型，并集成Filesystem MCP Server工具进行文件系统操作，期望工具调用正常工作以避免幻觉结果。

title: AI tool to generate test cases from English and convert to executable code with debugging
description: 用户需要一款AI工具，能够从自然语言的英文需求编写测试用例，自动转换为JavaScript、Java或Python等可执行测试代码，并支持调试失败用例、提供修复建议，以及在应用变更时维护或重构测试代码。
pain_point: 手动编写测试代码耗时且容易出错，缺乏从自然语言到可执行代码的自动化转换，测试失败时难以快速定位和修复，应用变更后测试代码维护困难，且现有工具往往需要重企业许可证或成本高。
use_case: 在软件测试和开发自动化中，用户希望用纯英文编写测试用例，工具将其转换为可执行测试代码（如JavaScript、Java、Python），并帮助调试失败的测试用例或建议修复，以及在应用程序变更时维护或重构测试代码。

title: Monorepo + AI tools (Copilot, Cursor): full codebase context providing practical benefits
description: User is evaluating whether monorepo setups with AI-assisted development tools (like Copilot, Cursor) provide real advantages over multi-repo setups, especially for TypeScript-heavy codebases with shared domain logic. They hypothesize that full codebase context could improve refactors touching shared APIs, propagating changes across apps, consistency in reusable methods/types, and reducing copy/paste-driven divergence, but seek validation from others' practical experiences.
pain_point: Multi-repo inconsistencies and bugs fixed in one project but not in others; shared functionality duplication leading to divergence and extra maintenance overhead.
use_case: Working in a frontend environment with multiple applications and shared libraries; historically projects lived in separate repositories with duplicated or partially reused shared functionality; now evaluating monorepos (Nx/Turborepo) from the angle of AI-assisted development to see if full codebase context improves AI suggestions/refactors.

title: 修复 Azure AI 搜索性能测试工具中 output.xml 文件缺失错误
description: 用户在使用 Azure AI 搜索性能测试工具时，通过 load-test.yml 创建了 pipeline，但在将下载的测试工件转换为 output.xml 文件时失败，提示文件缺失。用户是 Terraform 新手，需要具体的指导来解决这个错误。
pain_point: 转换脚本执行时找不到必要的输入文件，导致 pipeline 无法完成，用户作为 Terraform 新手难以自行调试。
use_case: 用户通过负载测试 YAML 文件创建了 Azure pipeline，希望下载测试工件并转换为 output.xml 格式，但转换脚本失败，提示目标文件缺失。

title: Unable to run mksdcard SDK tool error on Ubuntu
description: User keeps getting 'Unable to run mksdcard SDK tool' error in the setup wizard and terminal while trying to install Android Studio on Ubuntu.
pain_point: Continuous error in setup wizard and terminal about mksdcard SDK tool, blocking installation progress.
use_case: Trying to install Android Studio on Ubuntu via setup wizard, but encountering 'Unable to run mksdcard SDK tool' error in both wizard and terminal, preventing successful installation.

title: Spring AI工具调用中后续确认的上下文保持
description: 用户在Spring AI工具调用中使用RAG动态选择工具，当用户输入简短的确认词（如'yes'、'confirm'）或后续澄清问题时，RAG系统无法正确选择对应的工具，导致上下文丢失，使得状态管理和意图保留变得复杂。用户需要一种设计模式来在工具调用中处理后续确认而不丢失原始上下文。
pain_point: 当用户输入短确认词时，RAG工具过滤失败，因为缺乏上下文；多个后续澄清问题需要由单个工具管理，导致状态管理和意图保留复杂，无法干净地处理对话流程。
use_case: 使用Spring Boot 3.4.5和Spring AI 1.0.0集成Llama3.2模型，通过RAG动态过滤工具集，并在工具调用后需要处理用户的后续确认（如'yes'）或澄清问题（如'change the name'），要求保持原始意图上下文。

title: Passing runtime input variables to OpenAPI tool in Azure AI Foundry
description: User is unable to pass runtime input variables (e.g., bearer token) from agent input to an OpenAPI tool when using Azure AI Foundry Create Agent. The tool invocation either sends empty/incorrect values or fails with validation errors. User seeks a method to correctly pass these variables, besides prompt engineering, and asks for guidance on ensuring the agent understands the mapping.
pain_point: The OpenAPI tool invocation either sends empty or incorrect values for runtime input variables, or fails with a validation error (e.g., missing headers / bad request), indicating that the agent is not correctly mapping user-provided inputs to the tool's expected parameters
use_case: Creating an agent in Azure AI Foundry that calls an OpenAPI tool; the agent needs to pass runtime input variables (like a bearer token in the header) from the agent input/agent message to the OpenAPI tool; the agent should use the provided token for authentication during tool invocation

title: Post-hoc explainable AI method for complex CNN architectures like Mask R-CNN
description: User is seeking an easily applicable post-hoc explainable AI tool specifically for detections made by complex CNN-based architectures, such as Mask R-CNN.
pain_point: Lack of an easily applicable post-hoc explainable AI method for complex CNN architectures, specifically as evidenced by the question about Mask R-CNN.
use_case: Explaining detections carried out by complex CNN-based architectures like Mask R-CNN using a post-hoc, easily applicable method.

title: Enable/disable MCP servers or tools in Spring AI MCP Client
description: User wants to implement functionality to disable an entire MCP module or a specific tool, similar to Cloud Desktop's capability, using Spring AI and MCP Client. They propose creating a REST API to list active tools and deactivate them, but lack understanding of how MCP Client works within Spring.
pain_point: User does not understand how the MCP Client part works within Spring, hindering their ability to implement the disable functionality.
use_case: User wants to create a REST API where a user can list active tools and deactivate them, mimicking Cloud Desktop's disable MCP server or specific tool feature.

title: Security Context Not Propagated in Spring AI MCP Server Tool Calls
description: 用户在使用Spring AI MCP Server时，客户端发送的请求携带bearer token，列表工具正常，但调用工具时安全上下文丢失，错误提示'Security Context is invalid'。问题源于MCP server将工具执行委托给boundedElastic线程，不传播原始请求的SecurityContext，导致无法获取organizationId等参数。用户尝试了RequestContextHolder、Mdc、自定义provider等方法均未成功，寻求推荐配置或工作区方案。
pain_point: MCP server将工具调用委托给boundedElastic线程，但没有传播原始请求的SecurityContext，导致'Security Context is invalid'错误；尝试使用RequestContextHolder、Mdc等方法均未能成功传播，自定义provider也改变了行为并导致工具列表获取失败。
use_case: 用户在Spring Boot应用中集成Spring AI MCP Server (spring-ai-starter-mcp-server-webmvc)，另一Spring Boot应用作为客户端发送带bearer token的请求。正常列出工具时安全上下文有效，但调用具体工具时，MCP server将执行委托给boundedElastic线程，导致原始SecurityContext丢失，无法提供需要的organizationId等参数。

title: Spring AI MCP tools not returning response over SSE
description: The user has a Spring Boot application with Spring AI MCP server enabled and tools annotated with @Tool. The server logs show tools are registered. A Python client connects via SSE and can establish a session, but when sending tools/list or a custom tool (e.g., getJob), the Spring Boot server receives the request (mapped to WebMvcSseServerTransportProvider) but no response is sent back to the SSE queue. The client times out. The user asks for help debugging why the MCP server does not return responses over SSE.
pain_point: When sending tools/list or a custom tool request, the Spring Boot MCP server receives the request but does not send any response back to the SSE queue in Python, causing the client to time out. All tools (single-argument, multi-argument, returning objects like Job or long) exhibit the same behavior. The user cannot get any response from the MCP server over SSE, making the tools effectively unusable.
use_case: Invoking custom Spring AI MCP tools via SSE from a Python client. The user has a Spring Boot application with Spring AI MCP server enabled (spring.ai.mcp.server.enabled=true). Tools are defined as Spring @Service methods annotated with @Tool. The Python client connects to the MCP server via SSE at /management/mcp/message and sends JSON-RPC requests like tools/list or a custom tool (getJob). The expected result is for the server to return the response to the SSE queue so the client can receive it.

title: Building autonomous AI Agent with tool calling using Microsoft.Agents.AI
description: User needs a production-ready example or architecture for managing multi-step tool-calling loop safely, and guidance on state persistence, conversation history, and agent memory across multiple user sessions using native Microsoft AI libraries.
pain_point: Lack of clear production-ready example or architecture for safely managing multi-step tool-calling loop and handling state persistence, conversation history, and agent memory across multiple user sessions using the new pre-release Microsoft.Agents.AI framework.
use_case: Building an autonomous AI Agent inside a modern .NET application using Microsoft.Agents.AI and Microsoft.Extensions.AI packages, giving the agent access to custom native C# tools (database queries or internal APIs) to autonomously decide when to execute functions based on user intent, and needing to handle state persistence, conversation history, and agent memory across multiple user sessions.

title: 寻找免费的AI代码生成代理，类似Cursor在VS Code中使用
description: 用户希望找到一个免费的AI模型或代理，能够在VS Code中实现类似Cursor的代码生成功能，将计划转化为实际应用，但由于目前所有AI工具都需要付费，用户无法承担费用。
pain_point: 所有AI工具都是付费的，目前阶段无法支付token费用，无法使用Cursor这样的工具将计划转化为应用。
use_case: 作为开发者，想要使用AI将应用计划转化为实际代码，之前找到了Cursor但需要付费，希望找到免费的替代方案集成到VS Code中。

title: 使用Langchain4j的@Tool调用远程GraphQL API
description: 用户在使用Quarkus Langchain4j构建AI服务时，无法通过标注了@Tool的方法调用外部的GraphQL微服务，工具调用返回空，导致AI无法正确获取数据。用户已尝试多种配置，包括仅保留一个工具，但仍未成功。
pain_point: 工具调用返回空，AI服务未能实际调用标记了@Tool的方法来访问外部GraphQL API，导致返回空结果；用户已花费数天尝试，删除工具仍无效，核心功能被阻塞。
use_case: 使用Quarkus Langchain4j构建REST API，接收搜索文本，经过AI提取器处理后，通过客户端调用外部GraphQL微服务获取对象列表，并返回给REST API用户。

title: A9G GPRS+GPS模块固件烧录工具缺乏8955芯片支持
description: 用户需要为Ai-Thinker的A9G模块（含8955芯片）烧录固件，但官方Windows工具下载链接失效，Linux系统下的CoolWatcher烧录器缺少8955芯片选项，仅有8808等型号。用户询问能否手动添加8955芯片，或推荐可直接更换固件的替代GPS模块，并质疑公司是否已倒闭。
pain_point: 官方Windows工具下载链接失效（https://github.com/Ai-Thinker-Open/GPRS_CSDTK），Linux构建后CoolWatcher无8955芯片选项，无法烧录固件，且未找到可直接更换固件的替代GPS模块。
use_case: 用户需要在Linux Ubuntu 16环境下使用CoolWatcher烧录器为A9G模块中的8955芯片烧录固件，但工具缺少该芯片选项，仅支持8808、8808s、8809、8810、8810-AP、Gallite-8805、Gallite-8806。

title: Build strong programming fundamentals without using AI
description: A beginner programmer wants to develop solid fundamentals in logic building, problem solving, and understanding how programs work, and is concerned that heavy reliance on AI tools prevents deep conceptual understanding. The user seeks effective practice strategies, resources, and study approaches to learn programming deeply without depending on AI-generated solutions.
pain_point: Relying on AI tools to generate code or solve problems weakens the ability to fully understand programming concepts, preventing beginners from developing solid fundamentals in logic building and problem solving.
use_case: As a beginner learning programming, I want to build strong fundamentals in logic building, problem solving, and understanding how programs actually work, but I notice that many learners rely heavily on AI tools to generate code or solve problems, which prevents full understanding of concepts. I need effective methods such as practice strategies, learning resources, or study approaches that improve programming logic and conceptual understanding while avoiding reliance on AI-generated solutions.

title: List entity count definition in LUIS
description: 用户询问LUIS AI工具中显示的list entity count（x/50）实际含义是什么。
pain_point: UI中出现了数量指标但缺乏解释，用户不知道其代表什么，无法有效利用该信息。
use_case: 用户在使用LUIS时看到list entity count的显示，想理解其含义和具体作用。

title: AI对学习的影响分析
description: 用户讨论AI工具是否真正帮助学习加速，还是导致跳过学习过程，缺乏个人具体需求或痛点描述。
pain_point: 未明确指出具体痛点。
use_case: 用户发起关于AI对学习效果的讨论，寻求他人经验分享。

title: Variable Explorer not loading with deep learning script
description: User installed VS Tools for AI and ran a Python deep learning script. The Variable Explorer shows an error 'Error retrieving environment list' and fails to display variables. User seeks a solution to view variables in the executing script via the explorer.
pain_point: Variable Explorer shows 'Error retrieving environment list' and cannot load variables, preventing users from debugging or inspecting state during execution.
use_case: Running a Python deep learning script in Visual Studio using Anaconda 4.4.0 as the default environment, expecting the Variable Explorer to show current variables from the executing script.

title: 了解AI工具分享
description: 用户通过分享7个AI工具，表达了对AI工具的认知兴趣，但未提出具体的功能需求或使用痛点。
pain_point: 无明确痛点，仅为信息收集
use_case: 用户浏览AI工具分享帖子，获取工具列表和信息

title: 寻找真正惊艳的AI工具
description: 用户在试用数百款AI工具后，需要筛选出那些真正让人眼前一亮、有实际价值的工具，避免浪费时间在普通工具上。
pain_point: 很多AI工具很普通，用过就忘，难以找到真正有效、惊艳的工具。
use_case: 用户亲测数百款AI工具，从中挑选出值得推荐的部分，这些工具让人眼前一亮、惊艳。

title: 利用AI工具简化Kubernetes集群管理
description: 用户通过文章了解到OpenAI等AI工具可以帮助实现Kubernetes AIOps，期望找到能够简化K8s管理和运维的AI工具，降低复杂度。
pain_point: Kubernetes集群管理复杂，需要大量人工操作和专业知识，缺乏智能化的辅助工具来简化运维流程。
use_case: 用户想要了解和使用AI工具来辅助Kubernetes集群的日常运维，如自动化监控、故障排查等，以减轻管理负担。

title: 寻找AI实用工具
description: 用户希望找到实用的AI工具来提升生产生活便利性，但未明确具体需求。
pain_point: 用户可能面临信息过载，难以辨别哪些AI工具真正实用[未验证]。
use_case: 在数字化时代，用户希望从海量AI工具中筛选出实用的、能应用到生产生活各领域的工具。

title: 了解免费AI工具
description: 用户通过盘点文章了解主流免费AI工具，但未表达具体的功能需求或使用场景。
pain_point: 无具体痛点表达，仅泛泛了解。
use_case: 阅读免费AI工具盘点文章，获取工具信息。

title: 企业AI集成简化工具
description: 企业需要工具来简化AI与现有业务运营的集成，降低对基础设施和专业人才的大量投资需求，同时缓解数据隐私、道德影响和就业流失的担忧。
